Singapore, US agree to continue Megaspeed talks as Indonesian unit raided
Singapore and the US have agreed to keep discussing Megaspeed, the cloud-computing firm at the centre of the Nvidia scandal. The company's Indonesian unit was raided by police earlier this year. The case involves allegations that a former Megaspeed executive, Alice Huang, was a Chinese spy, and that
Singapore and the United States have agreed to continue discussions about Megaspeed, the Singapore-based cloud-computing company at the centre of the Nvidia scandal, while Megaspeed's Indonesian unit was raided by Indonesian police earlier this year, according to media reports.
Josephine Teo, Singapore's minister for digital development, discussed Megaspeed when she met with US Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau in Washington last week, the Straits Times reported. Singapore's ministry for digital development did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
Megaspeed has come under scrutiny after reports that Nvidia's former chief executive Jensen Huang had an affair with Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive whom US authorities suspect of being a Chinese spy. In October 2025, the New York Times reported that US authorities were investigating whether Megaspeed helped Chinese customers obtain Nvidia computer chips subject to Washington's export controls. China has denied the allegation and Megaspeed has not been found to have violated the rules.
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on 14 November that the Treasury, the Pentagon, the State Department and the US Trade Representative's Office had been in favour of putting Megaspeed on a trade blacklist for months, though the Commerce Department, which is in charge of the list, had not been. Megaspeed said on 16 November that Alice Huang left the company in August 2025 and that it conducts a 'legitimate and lawful business.'
Singapore said last week that Alice Huang had previously served as Megaspeed's chief executive, chairperson, and one of its key controllers. Police found insufficient evidence that she committed offences relating to suspected false declarations over server purchases, but warned her for knowingly providing inaccurate information that played down her role. Huang was barred from re-entering Singapore, while investigations into Megaspeed and six other individuals are ongoing, the home affairs ministry said.
The Straits Times also reported on 17 November that Indonesian authorities had raided a local Megaspeed unit as part of an inquiry requested by the US Federal Bureau of Investigation. Indonesian police found unopened server racks at the site, but no graphics processing units, the newspaper reported, citing an unnamed Indonesian government source. Indonesian police did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

content:
香港和新加坡的 Citi ULTIMA 持卡人获得 World Legend Mastercard 升级 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 16 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港和新加坡的 Citi ULTIMA 持卡人获得 World Legend Mastercard 升级
花旗和万事达卡为香港和新加坡的客户将 Citi ULTIMA 从 World Elite 升级为 World Legend Mastercard，这是万事达卡最高级别的消费卡。增强版卡提供精心策划的生活方式优惠，包括万事达卡系列和机场快速通道，加强了花旗的我们
花旗和万事达卡周一宣布将 Citi ULTIMA 从 World Elite 万事达卡升级为 World Legend Mastercard，为香港和新加坡的 Citi ULTIMA 持卡人带来万事达卡最高级别的消费卡级别。
增强版产品包括万事达卡系列，这是一套精选的全球餐饮、娱乐和旅行优惠。优惠范围包括优先预订令人垂涎的餐厅和广受欢迎的娱乐体验，以及为持卡人和最多三名客人（如果有）提供通过机场安检的万事达卡快速通道。 Citi ULTIMA 的个性化生活方式服务对这些服务进行了补充。
花旗表示，此次升级巩固了 Citi ULTIMA 作为花旗针对超高净值客户的受邀服务的地位，并强化了花旗财富致力于满足亚洲这一快速增长的细分市场不断变化的需求的承诺。
花旗北亚和澳大利亚财富主管 Vicky Kong 表示：“Citi ULTIMA 反映了我们与超高净值客户关系的深度，通过以他们最看重的事物为中心的准入、连通性和精心策划的体验来补充我们的财富专业知识。”
继花旗在美国推出全球首张此类卡之后，花旗和万事达卡在 World Legend Mastercard 上的合作就推出了该卡。此外，它将这一主张扩展到香港和新加坡这两个亚洲领先的国际财富中心的 Citi ULTIMA 客户。

Citi and Mastercard announced on Monday the elevation of Citi ULTIMA from World Elite to World Legend Mastercard, bringing Mastercard's highest consumer card tier to Citi ULTIMA cardholders in Hong Kong and Singapore.
The enhanced offering includes The Mastercard Collection, a curated suite of dining, entertainment and travel benefits around the world. Benefits range from priority reservations at coveted restaurants and sought-after entertainment experiences to Mastercard Fast Track through airport security for the cardholder and up to three guests, where available. These are complemented by Citi ULTIMA's personalised lifestyle services.
According to Citi, the upgrade strengthens Citi ULTIMA's position as Citi's invitation-only proposition for ultra-high-net-worth clients and reinforces Citi Wealth's commitment to serving the evolving needs of this fast-growing segment in Asia.
“Citi ULTIMA reflects the depth of our relationship with ultra-high-net-worth clients, complementing our wealth expertise with access, connectivity and curated experiences centred on what they value most,” said Vicky Kong, head of wealth for Asia North and Australia at Citi.
The launch builds on Citi and Mastercard's collaboration on World Legend Mastercard, following Citi's introduction of the first such card globally in the United States. Additionally, it extends the proposition to Citi ULTIMA clients in Hong Kong and Singapore, two of Asia's leading international wealth hubs.

香港房屋委员会2027年1月起提高停车场费 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 16 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港房屋委员会2027年1月起提高停车场费
考虑到市场趋势和财务审慎原则，香港房屋委员会将从 2027 年 1 月 1 日起小幅上调每月停车场费用。各区每小时停车费将上调1港元，日间及24小时停车费将分别上调10港元及15港元。电动汽车试点计划
香港房屋委员会（房委会）于 2026 年 11 月 16 日宣布，其商业楼宇小组委员会已批准适度增加其管理下的停车场费用，自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起生效。该决定是在对市场费率进行年度审查后做出的。
房委会发言人表示，市场研究发现，自上次检讨以来，同类停车场的月租费普遍上涨。此次调整旨在使房委会收费更接近现行市场水平，同时维持房委会的财务稳定。小组委员会批准略微调高各类停车位的月租费。
由2027年1月1日起，露天及有盖停车位每月收费将上涨如下：私家车露天停车位由350港元涨至380港元；私家车有盖停车场由港币 450 元至港币 480 元不等；轻型货车露天停车场由港币 450 元至港币 480 元起；轻型货车有盖停车场 550 港元至 580 港元；电单车露天停车场由港币 110 元至港币 120 元不等；摩托车有盖停车场价格为港币 140 至港币 150 元。
各区私家车、轻型货车及电单车每小时停车费将上调1港元。私家车「日间泊车」收费增加港币10元，「24小时泊车」收费则增加港币15元。
为配合政府推动电动车充电服务市场化的政策，房委会在辖下27个停车场推出试点计划，引入营办商提供电动车充电服务。小组委员会还批准自2027年1月1日起，在合适的试点停车场为月租停车证持有者设立专用的“充电共享区”。这些区域将允许月租用户在其停车场内共享充电器，让更多用户受益。
试点停车场的小时停车位将逐步过渡为运营商提供的收费服务。对于试点计划之外的停车场，现有电动车每小时充电费将由2027年1月1日起维持不变。试点计划下的所有充电费用将由营办商根据现行市场水平厘定，并须经房委会批准。

Hong Kong Housing Authority to raise carpark fees from January 2027 | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 16 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong Housing Authority to raise carpark fees from January 2027
The Hong Kong Housing Authority will slightly increase monthly carpark fees from 1 January 2027, citing market trends and financial prudence. Hourly rates will rise by HK$1 across all districts, while day and 24-hour parking rates will increase by HK$10 and HK$15 respectively. A pilot scheme for ele
The Hong Kong Housing Authority (HKHA) announced on 16 November 2026 that its Commercial Buildings Sub-committee has approved a modest increase in carpark fees under its management, effective 1 January 2027. The decision follows an annual review of market rates.
According to a HKHA spokesman, a market study found that monthly rental fees for comparable carparks had generally risen since the last review. The adjustment aims to bring HKHA charges closer to prevailing market levels while maintaining the authority's financial stability. The sub-committee approved a slight increase in monthly rental fees for all types of parking spaces.
From 1 January 2027, monthly rates for open and covered parking spaces will rise as follows: open parking for private cars will increase from HK$350 to HK$380; covered parking for private cars from HK$450 to HK$480; open parking for light goods vehicles from HK$450 to HK$480; covered parking for light goods vehicles from HK$550 to HK$580; open parking for motorcycles from HK$110 to HK$120; and covered parking for motorcycles from HK$140 to HK$150.
Hourly parking fees will rise by HK$1 across all districts for private cars, light goods vehicles and motorcycles. The "day parking" rate for private cars will increase by HK$10, while the "24-hour parking" rate will rise by HK$15.
To support the government's policy of marketising electric vehicle (EV) charging services, the HKHA launched a pilot scheme at 27 of its carparks, bringing in operators to provide EV charging. The sub-committee also approved the establishment of dedicated "charging sharing zones" for monthly parking permit holders at suitable pilot carparks from 1 January 2027. These zones will allow monthly users to share chargers within their carpark, benefiting more users.
Hourly parking spaces at pilot carparks will gradually transition to operator-provided charging services. For carparks outside the pilot scheme, existing hourly EV charging fees will remain unchanged from 1 January 2027. All charging fees under the pilot scheme will be set by operators based on prevailing market levels, subject to HKHA approval.

zh_title: 随着全球差距扩大，金管局将提高中小企业贸易融资准入
summary: 随着全球差距扩大，金管局将提高中小企业贸易融资准入 |中国劳工布告栏 星期一，2026 年 11 月 16 日·香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港金管局将在全球贸易融资缺口扩大的情况下提高中小企业贸易融资准入 在全球贸易融资缺口不断扩大的情况下，香港央行将优先考虑为中小企业提供更好的贸易融资准入。数据共享平台已处理超过 130,000 份贷款申请。该市还计划对电子贸易文件进行立法修订。香港将优先考虑为企业，特别是中小型企业提供更好的贸易融资机会
content:
随着全球差距扩大，金管局将提高中小企业贸易融资准入 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 16 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
随着全球差距扩大，金管局将提高中小企业贸易融资准入
在全球贸易融资缺口不断扩大的情况下，香港央行将优先考虑为中小企业提供更好的贸易融资渠道。数据共享平台已处理超过 130,000 份贷款申请。该市还计划对电子贸易文件进行立法修订。
香港金融管理局（金管局）周一表示，随着全球贸易融资缺口因供应链重组而扩大，香港将优先为企业，特别是中小企业（SME）提供更好的贸易融资机会。
金管局总裁余伟文在香港管理专业协会 2026 年年会上表示，作为金融和贸易中心，香港的目标是协调贸易流动，帮助企业扩大、联系和增长，同时缩小 2.5 万亿美元（19.6 万亿港元）的全球贸易融资缺口，随着供应链因持续的贸易紧张和冲突而重新调整，这一缺口有可能扩大。
“这也提醒我们，我们应该不断增强全球贸易体系的敏捷性，增强其韧性，特别是在全球供应链网络正在经历根本性重构的情况下，”他补充说，贸易融资始终是供应链韧性的支柱。
岳表示，自金管局于2022年推出商业数据交换（CDI）以来，银行可通过该数据共享平台获取经过验证的业务记录以评估中小企业的信誉度，已处理了超过13万份贷款申请，并批准了超过100亿港元的贷款，将中小企业的平均借款利率降低了36个基点。
香港将继续推进其货运数据计划“Project CargoX”。他表示，该项目旨在利用货物和贸易数据部署自动化分析，以消除审批瓶颈，目前正在与上海数据局和 PAA 数字贸易联盟在中国大陆及其他地区探索跨境用例。
此外，高效的贸易生态系统还需要坚实的法律基础。他补充说，香港将于本周向立法会提交《联合国电子可转让记录示范法》的立法修正案，为提高电子贸易文件的使用效率和减少操作摩擦奠定法律基础。

HKMA to boost SME trade finance access as global gap widens | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 16 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
HKMA to boost SME trade finance access as global gap widens
Hong Kong's central bank will prioritise better trade finance access for SMEs amid a widening global trade finance gap. A data-sharing platform has facilitated over 130,000 loan applications. The city also plans legislative amendments for electronic trade documents.
Hong Kong will prioritise better access to trade finance for businesses, particularly small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), as the global trade finance gap widens amid supply-chain restructuring, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said on Monday.
As a financial and trade hub, the city aims to intermediate trade flows, helping businesses expand, connect and grow while narrowing a US$2.5 trillion (HK$19.6 trillion) global trade finance gap, which risks widening as supply chains realign with ongoing trade tensions and conflicts, HKMA chief executive Eddie Yue Wai-man said at the Hong Kong Management Association annual conference 2026.
“It also reminds us that we should keep enhancing the agility of the global trade system and strengthening its resilience, especially when the global supply chain network is undergoing quite fundamental reconfiguration,” he said, adding that trade finance is always the backbone of supply chain resilience.
Since the HKMA launched Commercial Data Interchange (CDI) in 2022, the data sharing platform for banks to access verified business records to gauge SME creditworthiness has facilitated more than 130,000 loan applications and over HK$10 billion in approved lending, lowering average SME borrowing rates by 36 basis points, Yue said.
Hong Kong will press ahead with its cargo-data initiative, Project CargoX. Launched to deploy automated analytics using cargo and trade data to remove approval bottlenecks, the project is exploring cross-border use cases with the Shanghai Data Bureau and the PAA Digital Trade Alliance in the Chinese mainland and beyond, he said.
Moreover, an efficient trade ecosystem also requires a robust legal foundation. Drawing on the Model Law on Electronic Transferable Records of the United Nations, Hong Kong will table legislative amendments before the Legislative Council this week, putting in place a legal foundation to use electronic trade documents with greater efficiency and lower operational friction, he added.

title: NWD retail investors face $9,900 dilution cost as banks slash targets
zh_title: 由于银行削减目标，新世界发展散户投资者面临 9,900 美元的稀释成本
summary: 银行大幅削减目标，新世界发展散户投资者面临 9,900 美元的稀释成本中国劳工布告栏 星期一, 2026 年 11 月 16 日·香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 新世界发展散户投资者因银行大幅削减目标而面临 9,900 美元的稀释成本 新世界发展的散户投资者必须支付每手 9,900 港元，以避免因 249 亿港元供股而被稀释 75.3%。里昂信贷银行、摩根大通和花旗银行等主要银行均大幅下调了目标价格。香港机场管理局的选择权可能会被稀释至2.48%。新世界发展（NWD）的散户投资者面临着严峻的财务困境
content:
银行大幅削减目标，新世界发展散户投资者面临 9,900 美元的稀释成本中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 16 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
由于银行削减目标，新世界发展散户投资者面临 9,900 美元的稀释成本
新世界发展的散户投资者必须支付每手9,900港元，以避免因249亿港元的供股而被稀释75.3%。里昂信贷银行、摩根大通和花旗银行等主要银行均大幅下调了目标价格。香港机场管理局的选择权可能会被稀释至2.48%。
据《标准报》报道，新世界发展 (NWD) 的散户投资者在保留其股份方面面临着巨大的财务障碍，因为主要投资银行在其 249 亿港元供股后大幅稀释了该开发商的目标价格。
每手1,000股股份，少数股东须支付9,900港元，以每股0.90港元的价格认购11,000股供股股份。那些选择退出的人理论上面临 75.3% 的稀释效应。此次大规模现金募集将使该开发商的已发行股本从约25.1亿股增加至302亿股，其中新发行的股票占扩大后股本的91.7%。
沃康证券投资经理梁杰文建议不愿意注入更多现金的散户投资者应尽早退出，并警告称，如果商业地产市场持续疲软，新世界发展可能需要在三年内再次筹集现金。
11配1供股已促使各大银行大幅下调评级。里昂信贷证券亚洲将新世界发展的目标价从10港元下调一半以上至4.46港元，维持“持有”评级。该券商指出，股价上涨12倍将导致每股账面价值从59.50港元大幅摊薄至5.76港元。
摩根大通也维持“中性”评级，但将目标价下调58.8%至2.80港元。该行预计短期内股价将在 2 至 3 港元之间波动，并指出资本重组不会从根本上改变游戏规则。花旗维持目标价为6.90港元，但预计供股将摊薄新世界发展每股资产净值87.8%至2.53港元。该银行预计2027和2028财年的每股收益将分别下降81%和92%。
与此同时，瑞银和美国银行维持该股的“卖出”和“跑输大盘”评级。瑞银指出，折扣规模震惊了市场。美国银行指出，即使将永续债视为债务，开发商的净债务与股本比率仍高达75%左右，这令近期恢复派息的希望黯淡。
香港机场管理局持有新世界发展控股股东周大福企业于9月30日授予的购股权，可在三年内以22.5亿港元（即每股3港元）购买最多7.5亿股新世界发展股份。虽然这些期权最初代表了近 30% 的股权，但大规模配股可能会将潜在持股稀释至仅 2.48%。梁指出，如果除权后股价跌至1港元左右，当局将没有经济动力去行使3港元的期权。

NWD retail investors face $9,900 dilution cost as banks slash targets | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 16 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
NWD retail investors face $9,900 dilution cost as banks slash targets
Retail investors in New World Development must pay HK$9,900 per board lot to avoid 75.3% dilution from a HK$24.9 billion rights issue. Major banks including Credit Lyonnais, JPMorgan and Citi have slashed target prices. Hong Kong Airport Authority's options could be diluted to 2.48%.
Retail investors of New World Development (NWD) face a steep financial hurdle to retain their stakes, as major investment banks slashed the developer's target prices following its highly dilutive HK$24.9 billion rights issue, according to a report in The Standard.
For every board lot of 1,000 shares, minority shareholders must shell out HK$9,900 to subscribe to 11,000 rights shares at HK$0.90 each. Those who opt out face a theoretical dilution effect of 75.3 per cent. The massive cash call will swell the developer's issued share capital from about 2.51 billion to 30.2 billion shares, with the newly issued stock accounting for 91.7 per cent of the enlarged base.
Mike Leung Kit-man, investment manager at Wocom Securities, advised retail investors unwilling to inject more cash to exit early, warning that NWD might need another cash call in three years if the commercial property market remains weak.
The 11-for-1 rights issue has prompted sweeping downgrades from major banks. Credit Lyonnais Securities Asia slashed its target price for NWD by more than half to HK$4.46 from HK$10, maintaining a 'hold' rating. The brokerage noted the 12-fold increase in shares will lead to a sharp dilution of the book value per share from HK$59.50 down to HK$5.76.
JPMorgan also maintained a 'neutral' rating but cut its target price by 58.8 per cent to HK$2.80. The bank expects the share price to fluctuate between HK$2 and HK$3 in the near term, noting the capital restructuring will not be a fundamental game-changer. Citi kept its target price at HK$6.90 but projected the rights issue will dilute NWD's net asset value per share by 87.8 per cent to HK$2.53. The bank estimates earnings per share for the 2027 and 2028 fiscal years will plunge by 81 per cent and 92 per cent, respectively.
Meanwhile, UBS and Bank of America maintained 'sell' and 'underperform' ratings on the stock. UBS noted the discount scale shocked the market. Bank of America pointed out the developer's net debt-to-equity ratio remains high at around 75 per cent even after treating perpetual bonds as debt, dimming hopes for a near-term dividend resumption.
Hong Kong Airport Authority holds options granted by NWD's controlling shareholder Chow Tai Fook Enterprises on 30 September to purchase up to 750 million NWD shares for HK$2.25 billion, or HK$3 per share, within three years. While the options originally represented a near 30 per cent stake, the mega rights issue threatens to dilute that potential holding to just 2.48 per cent. Leung noted that if the stock price drops to around HK$1 after going ex-rights, the authority will have no financial incentive to exercise the HK$3 options.

香港新增三例退伍军人病病例 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 16 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港新增三宗退伍军人病个案
香港卫生防护中心于11月8日至14日报告三宗新的退伍军人病病例，其中两宗是社区感染个案，以及一宗输入个案，涉及一名曾到过中国内地的62岁女子。今年病例总数已达 178 例，卫生官员表示
卫生署11月16日宣布，香港卫生防护中心在11月8日至14日一周内新增三例退伍军人病病例。这些病例包括两例社区感染病例和一例输入性病例，涉及两男一女，年龄介乎62至67岁，均患有慢性病。
社区个案涉及一名居住屯门区的63岁男子及一名居住黄大仙区的67岁男子。境外输入病例为一名62岁女性，潜伏期曾到过中国大陆。该中心已启动流行病学调查，以确定潜在的感染源和高风险暴露因素。初步调查结果显示，这些病例均为散发病例，与香港先前确诊的病例没有流行病学联系。
截至11月14日，香港今年已录得178宗退伍军人病个案，而2025年为167宗，2024年则为135宗。该病对男性、50岁以上人士、吸烟者、酗酒者和免疫系统较弱的人士构成较高风险。其他风险因素包括供水系统维护不善、使用老式供水系统、靠近冷却塔或喷泉、使用电热水器、按摩浴缸、温泉以及最近入住酒店或船上。
军团菌在 20 至 45 摄氏度的温水环境中大量繁殖，包括水箱、冷热水系统、冷却塔、按摩浴缸、喷泉、加湿器和家庭呼吸医疗设备。感染是通过吸入人造水系统中受污染的水滴或气溶胶，以及通过处理花园土壤、堆肥或盆栽混合物而发生的。
卫生当局已向免疫功能低下者发出具体建议，包括使用无菌水或开水饮用、刷牙和漱口；避免使用加湿器或产生雾气的装置；如果使用此类设备，只能注入无菌水或新鲜煮沸的水，而不是自来水。应根据制造商的说明清洁和维护设备，每天清空并彻底干燥。
一般公共卫生建议包括保持个人卫生、避免吸烟和饮酒、定期清洁和除垢水龙头和淋浴喷头过滤器，以及不要使用家用滤水器，除非其孔径为 0.2 微米或更小，并定期更换过滤器。建筑水箱应至少每季度排水和清洁一次，不常用的出口应每周冲洗至少一分钟。对于那些处理花园土壤、堆肥或盆栽混合物的人，卫生官员建议戴手套和口罩，使用低水压灌溉，慢慢地打开盆栽混合物袋，使其远离脸部，换盆时湿润土壤，并避开通风不良的地方。

Monday, 16 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Three new Legionnaires' disease cases reported in Hong Kong
Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reported three new Legionnaires' disease cases from 8 to 14 November, including two community infections and one imported case involving a 62-year-old woman who had travelled to mainland China. The year's total has reached 178 cases, with health officials iss
Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection has recorded three new cases of Legionnaires' disease in the week from 8 to 14 November, the Department of Health announced on 16 November. The cases include two community infections and one imported case, involving two men and one woman aged between 62 and 67, all with pre-existing chronic illnesses.
The community cases involve a 63-year-old man living in the Tuen Mun district and a 67-year-old man residing in the Wong Tai Sin district. The imported case is a 62-year-old woman who had travelled to mainland China during the incubation period. The centre has launched epidemiological investigations to identify potential sources of infection and high-risk exposure factors. Preliminary findings indicate these are sporadic cases with no epidemiological link to previously confirmed cases in Hong Kong.
As of 14 November, Hong Kong has recorded 178 cases of Legionnaires' disease this year, compared with 167 cases in 2025 and 135 cases in 2024. The disease poses higher risks to men, people aged over 50, smokers, heavy drinkers, and those with weakened immune systems. Additional risk factors include poorly maintained water systems, use of old-style water systems, proximity to cooling towers or fountains, use of electric water heaters, jacuzzis, hot springs, and recent stays in hotels or on ships.
Legionella bacteria thrive in warm water environments between 20 and 45 degrees Celsius, including water tanks, hot and cold water systems, cooling towers, jacuzzis, fountains, humidifiers, and home respiratory medical equipment. Infection occurs through inhalation of contaminated water droplets or aerosols from man-made water systems, and also through handling garden soil, compost, or potting mix.
Health authorities have issued specific advice for immunocompromised individuals, including using sterile or boiled water for drinking, brushing teeth and rinsing; avoiding humidifiers or mist-producing devices; and if such devices are used, filling them only with sterile or freshly boiled water rather than tap water. Devices should be cleaned and maintained according to manufacturer instructions, emptied daily, and dried thoroughly.
General public health recommendations include maintaining personal hygiene, avoiding smoking and alcohol consumption, regularly cleaning and descaling tap and showerhead filters, and not using household water filters unless they have a pore size of 0.2 microns or less with regular filter changes. Building water tanks should be drained and cleaned at least quarterly, and infrequently used outlets should be flushed weekly for at least one minute. For those handling garden soil, compost or potting mix, health officials advise wearing gloves and masks, using low water pressure for irrigation, opening potting mix bags slowly away from the face, moistening soil when repotting, and avoiding poorly ventilated areas.
The government also urged smokers to call the Department of Health's integrated smoking cessation hotline at 1833 183 for professional counselling and referral to free smoking cessation services. Information on alcohol-related harms is available on the department's 'Live a Healthy New Direction' website.

香港大力推行爱国主义教育 首次庆祝中共建党三十周年中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 16 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港大力推行爱国主义教育 首次庆祝中共建党40周年
香港政府向立法者通报了爱国主义教育活动的最新情况，重点介绍了中国共产党成立周年纪念活动的首次官方庆祝活动。未来的举措将纪念长征胜利90周年和香港回归30周年
香港政制及内地事务局局长11月16日向立法会事务委员会表示，政府在推动爱国主义教育方面取得了重大进展。国务卿是在政制事务小组会议的开幕词中发表上述言论的，会上详细介绍了成就和未来计划。
政府于2024年4月在行政长官的指导下成立了爱国主义教育专责小组，并由布政司领导。专责小组协调政府部门和非政府组织，按照“一国两制”原则，培育以爱国爱港为核心的主流价值体系。秘书说，目标是引导公民从“认识国家”到“认同国家”，增强国家信心和认同感。
局长表示，最近公布的香港第一个五年规划明确提出要深化爱国主义、国家主义、安全主义、价值观教育，将其融入日常教学，培养有道德、有爱国心、有全球意识的一代。文件详细列出了过去一年各政策局和部门实施的短、中、长期措施。
秘书强调利用重要历史里程碑来促进爱国主义教育。 2025年，政府将庆祝中国人民抗日战争胜利80周年、东江水输港60周年和第十五届全国运动会。今年，政府首次正式庆祝中国共产党成立105周年，直接向公众宣传中国共产党的历史、执政理念和成就。
展望未来，局长表示，政府将利用长征胜利90周年、香港回归30周年以及香港有效载荷专家参与神舟二十三号载人航天任务来加深国家认同。政府还将继续相关部门持续进行的中长期努力。
书记说，爱国主义教育是一项长期、长期的事业，需要全社会共同努力。他表示，专责小组成功动员了政府和社会的爱国力量，香港市民特别是青少年的爱国主义情绪和国家认同明显增强。政府计划继续与专责小组及各界紧密合作，因地制宜举办更多有影响力的活动。

Hong Kong pushes patriotic education, marking CPC anniversary for first time | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 16 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong pushes patriotic education, marking CPC anniversary for first time
Hong Kong's government has updated lawmakers on its patriotic education campaign, highlighting a first-ever official celebration of the Chinese Communist Party's founding anniversary. Future initiatives will mark the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory and the 30th anniversary of Hong Kong's
Hong Kong's Secretary for Constitutional and Mainland Affairs told a Legislative Council panel on 16 November that the government has made significant progress in promoting patriotic education. The remarks came in an opening statement at a meeting of the Panel on Constitutional Affairs, where the secretary detailed achievements and future plans.
The government established a Patriotic Education Task Force in April 2024 under the Chief Executive's direction, led by the Chief Secretary. The task force coordinates government departments and non-governmental organisations to foster a mainstream value system centred on love for the country and Hong Kong, aligned with the 'one country, two systems' principle. The goal, the secretary said, is to guide citizens from 'knowing the nation' to 'identifying with the nation', enhancing national confidence and identity.
According to the secretary, the recently released First Five-Year Plan for Hong Kong explicitly commits to deepening patriotic, national, security, and values education, integrating them into daily teaching to cultivate a generation that is morally sound, patriotic, and globally aware. The document details short-, medium-, and long-term measures implemented by various policy bureaux and departments over the past year.
The secretary highlighted the use of key historical milestones to promote patriotic education. In 2025, the government marked the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, the 60th anniversary of Dongjiang water supplies to Hong Kong, and the 15th National Games. This year, for the first time, the government officially celebrated the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Chinese Communist Party, directly educating the public on its history, governance philosophy, and achievements.
Looking ahead, the secretary said the government will leverage the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory, the 30th anniversary of Hong Kong's return to China, and the participation of a Hong Kong payload specialist in the Shenzhou-23 crewed space mission to deepen national identity. The government will also continue ongoing medium- and long-term efforts across relevant departments.
The secretary described patriotic education as a steady, long-term endeavour requiring whole-society effort. He noted that the task force has successfully mobilised patriotic forces from government and society, leading to a noticeable rise in patriotic sentiment and stronger national identity among Hong Kong citizens, especially young people. The government plans to continue close cooperation with the task force and various sectors to organise more impactful activities tailored to Hong Kong's circumstances.

Hong Kong to become international shipping hub, Lee says

Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu said on Monday that the government is committed to transforming Hong Kong from a regional port into an international shipping hub.
This year's Policy Address focuses on high-value-added maritime services, closer cooperation with other Greater Bay Area cities, and the development of autonomous shipping suited for Hong Kong waters to drive decarbonisation and digitalisation, he said.
Speaking at the World Maritime Merchants Forum, Lee noted that the international shipping industry is undergoing unprecedented change. Amid geopolitical instability and reshaping supply chains, the sector requires more certainty and strategic coordination. He described Hong Kong as a reliable hub.
He also announced that Hong Kong will develop a green shipping corridor in partnership with Greece's Piraeus Port, marking an important step toward decarbonisation along the main maritime route between Asia and Europe.
Additionally, Hong Kong has established partner-port relationships with Yangpu Port in Hainan and signed a memorandum of understanding to develop a green energy corridor with Zhanjiang in Guangdong.

summary: 香港将数字共融计划扩展至400家机构，惠及40万名长者 |中国劳工公告 2026 年 11 月 16 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港将数码共融计划扩大至 400 家机构，惠及 40 万长者 香港首轮数码共融计划惠及超过 25 万长者。下一轮将于 2027 年 1 月启动，覆盖范围将扩大到 400 个机构和 90 多个支持点，目标覆盖 40 万老年人，包括农村和边远地区的老年人。政府首席信息办公室
content:
香港将数字共融计划扩展至400家机构，惠及40万名长者 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 16 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港将数码共融计划扩展至400家机构 惠及40万长者
香港首轮数码共融计划惠及超过25万名长者。下一轮将于 2027 年 1 月启动，覆盖范围将扩大到 400 个机构和 90 多个支持点，目标覆盖 40 万老年人，包括农村和边远地区的老年人。
政府资讯科技总监办公室于11月16日在数码港举行启动仪式，宣布两项新举措：「社区机器人」先导计划及下一轮「智慧之友」社区数码共融计划，分别计划于2026年12月及2027年1月展开。
创新科技及工业局局长孙东在仪式上致辞时表示，首轮“智慧之友”计划已惠及超过25万名长者。他补充说，下一轮预计将有超过 400,000 名参与者。
孙先生表示，新一轮服务将进一步扩大服务规模，参与机构增至400家，社区数字化服务支持点数量增加一倍多至90多个，覆盖范围也将扩大，包括农村和离岛地区。
孙先生表示，2026年施政报告宣布了“社区机器人”试点计划，以提高公众对实体智能的了解。计划借出的机器人名为“油池宝”，不仅会表演舞蹈和武术，还会与参与者互动，分享各种科技知识。

Monday, 16 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong to expand digital inclusion plan to 400 institutions, benefit 400,000 seniors
Hong Kong's first round of the digital inclusion plan benefited over 250,000 elderly people. The next round, launching in January 2027, will expand to 400 institutions and over 90 support points, aiming to reach 400,000 seniors, including those in rural and outlying areas.
The Office of the Government Chief Information Officer held a launch ceremony at Cyberport on 16 November, announcing two new initiatives: a pilot programme called 'Robots in the Community' and the next round of the 'Friends of Wisdom' community digital inclusion plan, scheduled to begin in December 2026 and January 2027 respectively.
Speaking at the ceremony, Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Mr Sun Dong said the first round of the 'Friends of Wisdom' plan had benefited more than 250,000 elderly people. He added that the next round is expected to reach over 400,000 participants.
Mr Sun stated that the new round would further expand service scale, increasing the number of participating institutions to 400 and more than doubling the number of community digital service support points to over 90. The plan will also cover more areas, including rural and outlying island districts.
According to Mr Sun, the 2026 Policy Address announced the 'Robots in the Community' pilot programme to enhance public understanding of embodied intelligence. The robot being loaned out under the programme is named 'Yau Chi Po', which will not only perform dances and martial arts but also interact with participants and share various technology knowledge.

title: 侯孝賢《童年往事》遭香港撤映 疑涉APEC維穩
summary: 香港「M+博物館」原定於11月22日和12月12日放映兩場侯孝賢在1985年拍攝的電影《童年往事》，近日突然宣布取消。（戴兵／大紀元） 【大紀元2026年11月16日訊】台灣名導侯孝賢的經典作品《童年往事》原定於香港「M+博物館」放映，但因未獲香港電影審查機構的許可，突然遭撤映。由於這個時間點正值亞太經合組織（APEC）峰會前夕，外界質疑與當局「政治維穩」有關。 香港「M+博物館」位於香港西九文化區，內設有專門的「M+戲院」，定期放映世界各地的經典電影和紀錄片，並舉辦專題影展
content:
香港「M+博物館」原定於11月22日和12月12日放映兩場侯孝賢在1985年拍攝的電影《童年往事》，近日突然宣布取消。（戴兵／大紀元）
【大紀元2026年11月16日訊】台灣名導侯孝賢的經典作品《童年往事》原定於香港「M+博物館」放映，但因未獲香港電影審查機構的許可，突然遭撤映。由於這個時間點正值亞太經合組織（APEC）峰會前夕，外界質疑與當局「政治維穩」有關。
香港「M+博物館」位於香港西九文化區，內設有專門的「M+戲院」，定期放映世界各地的經典電影和紀錄片，並舉辦專題影展等活動。館方原定於11月22日和12月12日放映兩場侯孝賢1985年拍攝的電影《童年往事》。11月13日，館方卻突然在官網以「技術問題」為由宣布取消所有場次。
直至14日，M+回覆「香港01」查詢時才改口表示，取消原因是香港電影、報刊及物品管理辦事處（電檢處）未批出放映許可。M+就此致歉，並稱已通知持票觀眾辦理退款。
該片1986年曾在香港正式上映，並錄得約76萬港元票房，如今時隔40年卻無法通過審查。由於這個時間點正值深圳舉行APEC峰會前夕，加上香港近期接連有多項藝文演出與商業活動遭取消，外界普遍推測此次《童年往事》撤映與維穩考量脫不了關係。
對此，香港電檢處回應「香港01」稱，當局一直按《電影檢查條例》的規定及既定機制處理所有影片的送檢申請，不會就個別影片作出評論。
據報導，館方於11月21日至12月18日舉辦「追光逐影：李屏賓的攝影藝術」專題展，精選10部由李屏賓掌鏡的作品，唯獨《童年往事》被取消，其餘9部作品均維持正常放映與售票，包括同樣由侯孝賢執導的《刺客聶隱娘》與《海上花》。
資料顯示，《童年往事》取材自侯孝賢的成長經歷，講述主角阿孝一家於1949年前後隨國民政府從中國大陸遷居台灣，在高雄鳳山生活成長的故事，影片展現出兩代人對中國大陸和台灣截然不同的身分歸屬與情感。
2021年11月，香港政府修訂《電影檢查條例》，明確將影片放映「是否不利於國家安全」列為審查考量。據統計，截至去年7月，有13部電影因「國安考慮」未獲批准上映，另有50部被要求修改內容，當中包括7部台灣電影。連同此次的《童年往事》，在香港至少已有8部台灣電影因電檢問題無法如期放映。

title: 中共修條例管控地方黨委 分析：地方不服中央
summary: 2025年3月11日，中共全國人大會議閉幕式上，代表們在北京大會堂閱讀報紙。(Kevin Frayer/Getty Images) 【大紀元2026年11月16日訊】（大紀元記者唐兵綜合報導）中共中央修訂的《中國共產黨地方委員會工作條例》日前發布，該條例首先強調地方委員會必須「堅定維護以習近平為核心的黨中央權威和集中統一領導」，還有針對地方「新官員不理舊帳」等問題。分析人士認為，中共新規出爐，恰恰說明地方不服中央，當局不得不加碼嚴控。 據中共央視新聞11月15日報導，中共官方
content:
2025年3月11日，中共全國人大會議閉幕式上，代表們在北京大會堂閱讀報紙。(Kevin Frayer/Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月16日訊】（大紀元記者唐兵綜合報導）中共中央修訂的《中國共產黨地方委員會工作條例》日前發布，該條例首先強調地方委員會必須「堅定維護以習近平為核心的黨中央權威和集中統一領導」，還有針對地方「新官員不理舊帳」等問題。分析人士認為，中共新規出爐，恰恰說明地方不服中央，當局不得不加碼嚴控。
據中共央視新聞11月15日報導，中共官方11月7日發布修訂的《中國共產黨地方委員會工作條例》，並發出通知，要求各地區各部門認真執行。
該條例修訂後共7章34條，開頭就強調中共地方委員會必須堅定維護以習近平為核心的「黨中央權威和集中統一領導」。
中國問題專家李林一對大紀元分析說，中共往往是缺什麼喊什麼，中共新規出爐，恰恰說明地方不服中央，當局不得不加碼嚴控。中央立規要地方擁護中央，這本身就說明地方不太擁護習中央，習近平權力極大，但權威卻大失。
近年被中共官方指控「妄議中央」的高官越來越多。前年叛逃到美國的甘肅省委統戰部前副部長馬瑞林在接受美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）採訪時表示，大多數「體制內」的人都不喜歡黨魁習近平，只是表面上吹捧他。
印太戰略智庫執行長、日本資深媒體人矢板明夫早前發文表示，習近平加大整肅官員，加強黨內控制，意味著其面臨政治困境，也就是權力愈大愈不安。
中共修訂地方黨委工作條例，還提出禁止地方搞「形象工程」和「政績工程」、違規新增地方政府隱性債務以及新官不理舊帳等行為。
中共中紀委、財政部近年多次通報地方政府隱性債務典型案例。其中，已落馬的貴州省委前常委、畢節市委前書記吳勝華被通報「新官不理舊帳」。吳勝華多次公開稱，「債都是前面欠的，憑什麼讓我還」。
李林一表示，中國經濟持續下行，地方債務問題正在加劇中共內鬥。中共整個化債過程實際就是中央和地方的博弈，使化債淪為政治鬧劇。

AUKUS 调查的怀疑只有一种方式
“以中国对澳大利亚构成战略威胁为前提，AUKUS 增加了澳大利亚卷入与中国的战争的可能性——这对我们国家的未来来说是最糟糕的结果。”
AUKUS 公共调查机构本月发布的一份报告（在新窗口中打开）中的一项调查结果如此写道，该机构是澳大利亚和平与安全论坛的一项倡议，得到了工会和社区团体的支持。
这份报告的优点之一是揭露了历届澳大利亚政府拒绝详细说明这些有关中国威胁的“断言”。
该报告的主要弱点是它也忽略了这一点。
AUKUS 于 2021 年创建，理由是澳大利亚需要核动力潜艇来加强美国在该地区的力量。莫里森政府及其顾问认为，如果没有这种权力，澳大利亚和亚洲所有其他国家都将受到北京的摆布。他们必须与正在崛起的该地区新霸主中国达成和解。换句话说，如果美国不在亚洲掌权，中国就会掌权，这实际上迫使澳大利亚以有利于北京的条件求和。
这一假设是 AUKUS 的核心逻辑，但 AUKUS 公共调查报告中几乎没有提及。当该报告确实简短地承认了中国实力增长的问题时，它很快就被驳回了：
中国现在是全球超级大国和亚洲地区的主导力量。中国在南海的活动水平及其在东南亚和太平洋地区影响力范围的扩大给澳中关系带来了挑战。中国也是我们最大的贸易伙伴，也是我们未来繁荣的核心。 AUKUS 通过帮助遏制中国来直接威胁这种共存。显然，AUKUS的决定是基于来自中国的毫无根据的威胁，符合美国遏制和对抗中国的政策。
该报告引用了调查提交的内容，淡化了中国对澳大利亚的军事威胁。中国可能袭击澳大利亚境内的美国基地是一个例外，但有人认为，如果没有这些基地，中国与澳大利亚没有争执，也几乎不可能攻击澳大利亚。
我本人曾警告过（在新窗口中打开）美国新的“轮换”存在——除了名义上的军事基地——将使澳大利亚成为中国的潜在目标，我同意这种风险超过了澳大利亚从这些基地获得的安全利益。但也需要承认，即使没有这些设施，澳大利亚仍将面临中国军事的风险。
即使没有美国的力量，中国也不会自动成为该地区的霸主。
这份报告对中国的发展非常正确

|AUKUS inquiry scepticism runs only one way
AUKUS inquiry scepticism runs only one way
“Premised as it is on assertions that China is a strategic threat to Australia, AUKUS increases the likelihood of Australia becoming involved in war with China – the worst possible outcome for our nation’s future.”
So reads one finding of a report (Opens in new window) issued this month by the AUKUS Public Inquiry, an initiative of the Australian Peace and Security Forum and supported by trade unions and community groups.
One of the strengths of this report is that lays bare the refusal by successive Australian governments to detail these “assertions” about the threat from China.
The principal weakness of the report is that it also neglects to do so.
AUKUS was created in 2021 on the basis that Australia needed nuclear-powered submarines to reinforce American power in the region. The Morrison government and its advisers calculated that, without such power, Australia and every other nation in Asia would be at Beijing’s mercy. They would have to come to an accommodation with an ascendant China, the region’s new hegemon. In other words, if the US was not in charge in Asia, China would be, effectively forcing Australia to sue for peace on terms favourable to Beijing.
This presumption, the core logic that inspired AUKUS, is barely touched upon in the AUKUS Public Inquiry report. When the report does briefly acknowledge the problem of growing Chinese power, it is quickly waved away:
China is now a global superpower and the leading power in the Asian region. China's level of activity in the South China Sea and the expansion of its sphere of influence in southeast Asia and the Pacific introduces a challenging dimension to the Australia-China relationship. China is also our largest trading partner and central to our future prosperity. AUKUS directly threatens this coexistence by contributing to the attempted containment of China. It is clear the AUKUS decision was based on unsubstantiated threats from China and to accord with the US policy to contain and contest China.
The report is studded with quotes from inquiry submissions downplaying China’s military threat to Australia. An exception is made for the possibility that China might strike American bases on Australian soil, but without those bases, it is argued, China has no quarrel with Australia and is vanishingly unlikely to attack it.
I have myself warned (Opens in new window) that the new US “rotational” presence – military bases in all but name – will make Australia a potential Chinese target, and I agree that this risk exceeds the security benefits Australia gets from the bases. But it also needs to be acknowledged that, even absent these facilities, Australia will still be at risk from China’s military.
Even absent American power, China is not fated to automatically become the region’s hegemon.
The report is quite right about China’s regional ambitions but fails to acknowledge that they won’t magically go away if Australia cancels AUKUS or if US forces leave Australia and the region. The deeply concerning scale and sophistication of China’s ongoing military modernisation (Opens in new window) barely registers in the report.
If Beijing becomes utterly dominant in our region, it won’t have to invade. Australian compliance with China’s needs and ambitions will be achieved without the costly and dangerous business of actually using military force. That coercive power, which only comes from unchallenged strategic dominance, is the true threat, and it is the fear that inspired AUKUS: without American power, it was argued, there is only Chinese power.
Effective opposition to AUKUS should begin with a simple declaration that this dichotomy is false. It is false firstly because, even absent American power, China is not fated to automatically become the region’s hegemon. Australia and its partners get a say in this. They are not helpless. They have agency. One of the ways Australia can exercise that agency is by building a defence force so lethal and effective that China will never have the means to coerce it. AUKUS makes it harder to achieve that goal because it so expensive, slow and uncertain to produce results.
But the dichotomy is false also because AUKUS won’t help to cement American power in Asia. For Washington, AUKUS is simply a highly favourable arms deal. It does nothing to obligate the US to defend its regional position – one that has been weakening for more than a generation because it is unwilling to risk war with China.
As I said in my ABC Boyer Lecture (Opens in new window), Australian statecraft must now be built on dual scepticism: one superpower is in decline as a regional force while the other is on the rise, and Canberra should be wary of the motives of both. The weakness of the AUKUS Public Inquiry report is that it directs almost all its scepticism towards the United States and reserves little for China.
Sam Roggeveen is Director of the Lowy Institute’s International Security Program. He is the author of The Echidna Strategy: Australia's Search for Power and Peace (Opens in new window), and an Adjunct Professor at the University of Canberra.

content:
全国经济实力大会|活动 | 2026 年 11 月 17 日 | ITIF跳到内容
美国东部时间 2026 年 11 月 17 日星期二上午 08:30 至下午 4:00
Convene Hamilton Square, 4th Floor600 14th Street NW华盛顿特区
在一个具有重要战略意义的先进贸易行业产业群中，美国面临着将全球领导地位让给中国的严重风险，这些产业为 21 世纪的经济实力和国家安全提供了基础。 ITIF 将其称为“国家经济动力产业”。中国长期协调一致地主导这些行业并不是正常的经济竞争；这无异于一场旨在让美国和西方处于从属地位的技术经济贸易战。为了避免灾难性的失败，华盛顿的政策制定者需要做出根本性的政策改变。
立即注册加入 ITIF 参加重要的政策会议。顶尖专家将深入研究 ITIF 在史密斯·理查森基金会的支持下进行的为期 18 个月的研究工作的结果，讨论美国为避免输给中国而需要进行的政策改革，并考虑最近的中期选举对未来几年这些问题的预示。
最后更新于 11 月 10 日。
上午 8:00–9:00 — 登记和早餐
上午 9:00–9:25 — 欢迎和框架：ITIF 创始人兼高级研究员 Robert D. Atkinson 博士致辞
中国正在向支撑21世纪经济实力和国力的先进产业迈进。它已经是从计算机、电子到汽车等行业的全球领先生产商，并且正在迅速成为从机器人到人工智能和量子等尖端行业的领先创新者。这对美国的技术领先地位、实力和安全构成了生存威胁。为了避免失败，华盛顿必须放弃旧的技术经济和贸易政策学说，并采取新的国家电力工业战略。
第 1 部分：将技术经济安全纳入国家安全
上午 9:30–10:10 — 陆军部在技术经济安全中的作用
美国需要采取整体政府的方式来进行技术经济防御。这需要一个牵头机构进行机构协调。但哪个机构呢？商务部是一种可能性。另外，ITIF 建议建立一个新的、准公共的国家先进工业和技术机构 (NAITA)，其组织方式类似于进出口银行，但具有更大的灵活性。但无论这项努力如何组织，陆军部都需要发挥核心作用——毕竟，在美国政治和政府中，陆军部是唯一一个“工业政策”被认为是可以接受的，即使不是必要的。陆军部的角色应该是什么样的？
迈克尔·P·卡德纳齐 (Michael P. Cadenazzi)，负责工业基础政策的助理战争部长
Michael Brown，神盾资本合伙人、美国国防部国防创新部门（DIU）前主任
罗伯特·阿特金森 (Robert D. Atkinson)，ITIF（主持人）
上午 10:15–11:00 — 1948 Redux：打造国家技术经济安全机构
为了动员起来应对冷战，美国领导人从 1948 年起建立了国家安全机构，但反国家主义的本能却限制了这一机构，利用美国的经济实力，而不让该国变成一个集权的“驻军国家”。事实证明，这种克制是力量的源泉，帮助更加自由的美国战胜了集权对手。在中国，美国现在面临着更加强大的挑战

【原文 English Original】
National Economic Power Conference | Event | Nov 17, 2026 | ITIFSkip to content
Tuesday, November 17, 2026, 08:30 AM to 4:00 PM EST
Convene Hamilton Square, 4th Floor600 14th Street NWWashington DC
The United States is at grave risk of losing global leadership to China in a strategically vital group of advanced, traded-sector industries that provide the foundation for economic strength and national security in the 21st century. ITIF calls them “national economic power industries.” China’s coordinated long-term campaign to dominate these industries is not a normal economic competition; it is nothing short of techno-economic-trade war designed to put the United States and the West in a subservient position. To avoid a catastrophic defeat, policymakers in Washington will need to make fundamental policy changes.
Register now to join ITIF for an important policy conference. Leading experts will delve into the findings of an 18-month research effort that ITIF has conducted with support from the Smith Richardson Foundation, discuss policy reforms that are needed for America to avoid losing to China, and consider what the recent midterm elections portend for these issues in the years ahead.
Last updated on November 10.
8:00–9:00 a.m. — Registration and Breakfast
9:00–9:25 a.m. — Welcome and Framing: Remarks by Dr. Robert D. Atkinson, Founder and Senior Fellow, ITIF
China is on the march to dominate the advanced industries that underpin economic strength and national power in the 21st century. It is already the world’s leading producer in industries ranging from computers and electronics to motor vehicles, and it is rapidly becoming a leading innovator in cutting-edge industries from robotics to AI and quantum. This represents an existential threat to U.S. technological leadership, power, and security. To avoid defeat, Washington must jettison old techno-economic and trade policy doctrines and adopt a new national power industry strategy.
Part 1: Factoring Techno-Economic Security Into National Security
9:30–10:10 a.m. — The War Department’s Role in Techno-Economic Security
America needs a whole-of-government approach to techno-economic defense. That requires institutional coordination under a lead agency. But which agency? The Commerce Department is one possibility. Alternatively, ITIF has recommended establishing a new, quasi-public National Advanced Industry and Technology Agency (NAITA) organized like the Ex-Im Bank, but with greater flexibility. But no matter how the effort is organized, the War Department will need to play a central role—after all, it is the one place in U.S. politics and government where “industrial policy” is seen as acceptable, if not necessary. What should the War Department’s role look like?
Michael P. Cadenazzi, Assistant Secretary of War for Industrial Base Policy
Michael Brown, Partner, Shield Capital, and former director of the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) at the U.S. Department of Defense
Robert D. Atkinson, ITIF (moderator)
10:15–11:00 a.m. — 1948 Redux: Crafting the National Techno-Economic Security Establishment
To mobilize for the Cold War, U.S. leaders built a national security establishment from 1948 onward—yet anti-statist instincts restrained it, harnessing America’s economic might without letting the country harden into a centralized “garrison state.” That restraint proved to be a source of strength, helping a freer America outlast a statist rival. In China, the United States now faces a far more formidable techno-economic competitor than the Soviet Union ever was. What can the post-1948 mobilization teach U.S. policymakers today about building a durable strategy without sacrificing what makes America strong?
Remarks by Aaron Friedberg, Professor Emeritus of Politics and International Affairs, Princeton University, and author of Getting China Wrong (Polity Books, 2022)
Discussion with Robert D. Atkinson, ITIF
11:10 a.m.–12:10 p.m. — Panel: Over-the-Horizon Techno-Economic Attacks
Washington has a hard time acting until it “sees the whites of their eyes.” By then it’s too late. What techno-industrial attacks are coming from the PRC but not yet fully recognized in Washington? The next fronts are already taking shape in biopharmaceuticals, commercial aviation, and robotics, among many other advanced industries.
Caitlin Frazer, Executive Director, National Security Commission on Emerging Biotechnology (NSCEB)
Stephen Ezell, Executive Vice President, Global Innovation Policy, ITIF
William Hannas, Lead Analyst, Georgetown’s Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET), and former member of the CIA’s Senior Intelligence Service
Mina Kim, Chief Economist and Director, Hamilton Center on Industrial Strategy, ITIF (moderator)
12:10–12:50 p.m. — Lunch Break
Part 3: What an Effective Response Looks Like
12:50–1:20 p.m. — Beyond Free Trade and Protectionism: Strategic Trade Partnerships
With the rise of mercantilist China, the longstanding free trade model is bankrupt. But across-the-board domestic protectionism is not the answer. The only way for the West to have the scale needed to avoid losing the techno-economic war to China is through deep strategic trade partnerships that incorporate not just trade policy, but also a host of other measures, including joint R&D, coordinated export and import controls, and commercial intelligence sharing.
Remarks by Peter Harrell, Visiting Scholar, Georgetown Institute for International Economic Law, and former Senior Director for International Economics in the Biden White House
Discussion with Rodrigo Balbontin, Associate Director, Trade, IP, and Digital Technology Governance, ITIF
1:25–1:55 p.m. — Beyond More Money: Structural Fixes for U.S. Science and Innovation Funding
For decades, America has assumed ideas flow naturally from basic research into commercialization. That assumption no longer holds. Indeed, the U.S. innovation system is no longer fit for purpose in an age of great-power rivalry with the PRC. The two countries operate from fundamentally different models of innovation. The United States follows a “river” logic: Produce frontier science and trust the market to carry discoveries downstream. China follows a “lake” logic: Absorb, develop, diffuse, and capture value. Professor Knot will draw on findings from her forthcoming book The US Innovation War with China to discuss seven myths shaping U.S. innovation policy what a reform agenda should look like.
Remarks by Anne Marie Knott, Robert and Barbara Frick Professor of Business, Washington University and author of The US Innovation War with China (forthcoming, Cambridge University Press)
Discussion with Robert D. Atkinson, ITIF
Part 4: The Political Challenge for Washington
2:05–2:45 p.m. — Beyond Financial Capitalism: National Power Capitalism
The single most important factor that will determine the outcome of the techno-economic-trade war with China is how U.S. firms make long-term investment decisions. The problem is that America’s current system of financial capitalism prioritizes paying profits to shareholders more than reinvesting earnings. To avoid losing to China, U.S. policymakers will need to rebalance that equation by ushering in a new system of “national power capitalism” that aligns shareholder interests with the national interest. That will require enacting major tax reforms to incentivize retained earnings and investment, and to disincentivize profit payouts; spurring “double bottom line” investment behavior that values national power; and creating targeted public sector investment vehicles.
Sree Ramaswamy, Chief Innovation Officer, NobleReach; former Senior Policy Analyst, U.S. Department of Commerce
Aniket Shah, PhD, Managing Director, Global Head of Washington, Sustainability & Transition Strategy, Jefferies Group LLC
Robert D. Atkinson, ITIF (moderator)
2:50–3:50 p.m. — Why So Little Appetite for National Economic Power Strategy?
For half a century, America led in technology and relied on process-based, free-market economics and unfettered globalization. The result was innovation and productivity, but serious loss of techno-industrial global competitiveness. China, in contrast, follows a goal-oriented system designed to dominate advanced industries that underpin national power. To avoid losing the techno-economic trade war with China, U.S. policymakers must now go beyond the “Overton window” and embrace bold new approaches to policy. Why has this been so hard? Why are China engagers regaining the high ground? Why has President Trump appeared to move from confrontation to détente? What will it take to get China back on the agenda as fundamental issue to national power? Is Washington capable of building a system that effectively promotes economic power and national security?
Ely Ratner, Principal, The Marathon Initiative, and former Assistant Secretary of Defense for Indo-Pacific Security Affairs in the Biden Administration
Liza Tobin, Managing Director, Garnaut Global, and former Director of China, National Security Council in the first Trump Administration
Robert D. Atkinson, ITIF (moderator)

华盛顿多年来一直在争论人工智能（AI）在核指挥和控制中的作用，并为中美关系的军事影响而苦恼。人工智能竞赛。它花更少的时间提出一个不同的问题：如果朝鲜领导人金正恩相信美国即将在通用人工智能领域获得强大、持久的优势，那么他的威慑计算将如何改变？
通用人工智能（AGI）——被定义为在认知任务中与人类表现相匹配的强大智能——可能会进一步破坏已经恶化的核威慑关系的稳定。较弱的非 AGI 能力可能会变得尤其成问题。朝鲜的核态势已经一触即发。如果美国获得通用人工智能或类似通用人工智能的能力，平壤可能会采取一种激进的“使用它或失去它”的心态，因为它担心第一次打击会消除其核武器能力并摧毁其领导层。
至关重要的是，美国实际获得 AGI 以及随后发展威慑无效能力，比朝鲜对美国能力和意图的看法更重要。由于平壤采取了咄咄逼人的核姿态，并对美国的意图持批评、偏执的态度，因此，即使在通用人工智能能力投入使用之前，局势也可能会急剧恶化。因此，应该更多地关注通用人工智能如何打破不对称威慑平衡，尤其是针对平壤。
如果通用人工智能的腾飞真正带来指数级增长，一连串的技术突破可能会刺激前所未有的经济增长和军事能力的扩张，有些人称之为代理战争。在这种情况下，具有通用人工智能能力的国家可能会迅速削弱（甚至消除）非通用人工智能国家的二次打击能力。这种技术飞跃将放大不幸的心理倾向，即在面临损失时变得更容易冒险，这被称为前景理论。
因此，在AGI起飞的情况下，非AGI核武器国家，尤其是实力较弱的国家，可能会担心在不久的将来他们将无法威慑AGI国家。因此，他们可以采取更具攻击性的姿态。当然，这并不是唯一的理性反应，但出于我们稍后将描述的原因，我们认为朝鲜更有可能以额外的侵略性做出反应，而不是通过生存、隐蔽和军控谈判寻求庇护。此外，如果递归自我改进能够实现超级人工智能（ASI）（定义为超越任何人类的能力），那么风险将变得更高，核决策时间将变得更加压缩。
AGI 的后果、时间表和扩散仍然是争论的主题，而关键的 AI
